_status: PROVISIONAL seed rules demonstrating the fidelity model. Not a complete library: per the project brief, the full library waits until the FIFA version and its real tactical surface are confirmed. Targets use knob names from data/configurations/fifa_capability_profiles.json.

very_defensive.rationale: FIFA game plans are a 5-step mentality ladder; FM's 7 steps collapse onto them.

cautious.rationale: No FIFA step between defensive and balanced; approximated with lower depth.

positive.rationale: No FIFA step between balanced and attacking; approximated with higher depth and more box runners.

much_higher_defensive_line.rationale: FIFA depth is the defensive-line height.

higher_defensive_line.rationale: FIFA depth is the defensive-line height.

lower_defensive_line.rationale: FIFA depth is the defensive-line height.

much_lower_defensive_line.rationale: FIFA depth is the defensive-line height.

much_more_urgent_pressing.rationale: Constant pressure is FIFA's highest pressing intent.

more_urgent_pressing.rationale: Intermediate pressing intent; trigger-based rather than intensity-based.

less_urgent_pressing.rationale: FIFA has no 'less urgent' step distinct from dropping off.

higher_line_of_engagement.rationale: FIFA does not separate line of engagement from defensive line; folded into depth.

counter_press.rationale: Same intent: win the ball back immediately after losing it.

regroup.rationale: Drop back approximates regrouping into shape.

counter.rationale: FIFA has no transition-specific instruction; expressed through attacking style.

higher_tempo.rationale: Tempo and build-up style are conflated in FIFA.

lower_tempo.rationale: Tempo and build-up style are conflated in FIFA.

more_direct_passing.rationale: Directness only in the final third.

shorter_passing.rationale: Possession chance creation favours short combinations.

play_out_of_defence.rationale: FIFA has no explicit play-out instruction; slow build-up keeps the ball on the ground.

use_offside_trap.rationale: No persistent custom-tactic equivalent identified (UNKNOWN for chosen version).

get_stuck_in.rationale: Tackling aggression is not a tactical knob; may be approximable via CPU sliders later.

work_ball_into_box.rationale: Patient final-third play approximated with possession.

inverted_wing_back.rationale: FIFA cannot express a full-back stepping into midfield in possession; we keep him narrower and less adventurous.

wing_back.rationale: Overlapping full-back intent maps to joining the attack.

half_back.rationale: Dropping between centre-backs to form a back three is not expressible; holding and covering centrally preserves part of the intent.

regista.rationale: Deep roaming playmaker; FIFA free roam is not depth-restricted.

segundo_volante.rationale: Late runs from deep to the edge of the box.

mezzala.rationale: Half-space drift approximated by drifting wide; FIFA lacks a half-space concept.

trequartista.rationale: Free role with no defensive duties.

pressing_forward.rationale: Individual pressing intensity is not a player instruction; approximated with work-back and aggressive interceptions.

inside_forward.rationale: Cutting inside is partly a foot/positioning effect FIFA decides itself.

ball_playing_defender.rationale: No passing-range instruction for defenders identified; expressed only through attributes.
